endorsements.label: Malicious Code & Wireless Networks
endorsements.description: With over 55,000 viruses circling the globe it is no wonder we are so paranoid about protection, but are we being paranoid enough? A new threat stands to potentially disrupt systems worldwide and cause hundreds of millions in damage.

endorsements.name: Brett Neilson
endorsements.label: The Advantages of Being an Amateur
endorsements.description: The Advantages of Being an Amateur For close to 100 years amateurs have been working with radios and sending transmission all over the world. The dawn of the information age has inspired many new technologies and advancements in communication; and amateur radio is no exception. Today’s modern amateur radio operators are building wireless networks and enjoying several advantages over their unlicensed counterparts. This presentation will review some of these advantages as well as talk about some of the newer areas of interest including HSMM and APRS.
